plang/programming-fundamentals/1-1-terms.comment: While the text excels in pedagogical clarity and structural conciseness, it frames foundational programming concepts through rigid binaries and absolute lifecycles. From the perspective of Liquid Philosophy, it treats compilation and execution as static, linear monuments rather than exploring dynamic, hybrid paradigms such as JIT compilation or evolving runtime environments. Consequently, its high explanatory precision comes at the expense of epistemic adaptability and openness.
